description: This PHP file defines the EmploymentStatusService class, which provides methods for managing employment status data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching employment statuses, utilizing a Data Access Object (DAO) and incorporating normalization via a trait.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusService
classes.description: Service class providing CRUD and search operations for employment statuses in the HRM system.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmploymentStatusDao instance.

methods.name: setEmploymentStatusDao
methods.description: Setter method to assign a custom EmploymentStatusDao instance.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmploymentStatus object matching the given ID.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Persists the provided EmploymentStatus object to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes employment statuses with specified IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching search criteria.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusArray
methods.description: Retrieves all employment statuses and normalizes them into an array.
